_about: Second Shiraz check, on PROVISIONAL products (17 Jun 2026 onward), which carry the processor's RFI filter; the BETA run (shiraz.json) predates it. CMR on 21 Oct 2026: 40 granules cover the site, tracks 56 and 157 ascending and 107 descending, all 20+5 MHz HH+HV. Whether the jammer is still on is unknown, so a miss here is not a failed known answer by itself; compare with the processor's rfiLikelihood. A hit from both directions is the first real ascending/descending cross-fix. Run from nisar/: python -m nisar_rfi run --config validation/shiraz_provisional.json --start 2026-06-17 --end 2026-10-21 --seed
